properties.summary: VIENNA — Five European Union countries plan to open a deportation hub in Rwanda for rejected asylum seekers, Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker said Monday. “If people without the right of residence in the EU cannot be removed, our entire asylum system is made a mockery of. And we are not going to allow that,” Stocker said.
